title: Wulbren's Hammer
summary: A +1 light hammer that adds 2d4 Force against objects.

fields.Weapon profile: Simple one-handed Light, Thrown and Dippable. 5 ft melee. Hit for 1d4 + 1 Bludgeoning plus Strength. +1 to attacks. Adds 2d4 Force against items and world objects, as reported by the source.
fields.Concussive Smash: Action with proficiency once per Short Rest. Deal weapon damage. Constitution save against the higher of spell save DC or weapon-action DC +2 prevents Dazed for 2 turns.
fields.Quest use: Give the hammer to Wulbren during Rescue Wulbren to help him break out. He recognizes his own hammer.
fields.Acquisition: On a table upstairs in the Moonrise Towers Prison Warden’s room (575, −647).
fields.Constructs: The item description also mentions Constructs for the 2d4 Force rider. The special rules row only confirms items and world objects.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay with pinned item and linked rules evidence. Reconciled applicable action, condition, and variant details against pinned rules.
